rules.statement: Byte lane i of the 32-bit data bus carries bits [8i+7:8i], and PSTRB[i] and a_mask[i] refer to the same lane.
APB address bits [1:0] shall be 0 (word-aligned byte address).
Bits [PARA_ADDR_W-1:2] of the APB address are copied to a_address[PARA_ADDR_W-1:2], and a_address[1:0] is 2'b00.
A non-zero value in APB address bits [1:0] shall give PSLVERR (REQ-ERR-002).
a_opcode shall be 3'b000 (PutFullData) for writes and 3'b100 (Get) for reads, with bit 2 as read and bits [1:0] zero.
a_opcode values other than 3'b000 and 3'b100 shall never be generated.
a_size shall be 2'b10 (4 bytes) and no other value shall ever be generated.
a_mask shall be 4'b1111 and no other value shall ever be generated (DEC-001).

rules.condition: d_opcode differs from the expected value (3'b000 AccessAck for writes, 3'b001 AccessAckData for reads)
rules.statement: Any d_opcode value other than the expected one shall give PSLVERR.

rules.condition: write transfer or any error completion
rules.statement: Read data shall be forced to 0 for writes and for every error completion.
